# IGUDAR

> IGUDAR è il coworker AI per i piani di sicurezza. Crea il digital twin del sito, simula gli scenari e aiuta il professionista a scrivere il piano; il professionista controlla, corregge e firma.

Canonical website: https://igudar.it/
Contact: contact@igudar.it
Primary language: Italian
Area served: Italy
Status: active development and 2026 pilot programmes

## What IGUDAR does

- Builds a measurable digital twin of the real site from surveys and plans.
- Simulates vehicle paths, impacts, egress and operational constraints before the event.
- Organizes calculations, evidence and references into the technical safety plan.
- Highlights assumptions and results so the qualified professional can review, correct and sign.

## Platform modules

1. Anti-vehicle risk: core module, validated on a real case study.
2. Egress: in development.
3. Capacity: in development.
4. Emergency access: in development.
5. Fire safety: in development.
6. Regulatory compliance: in development.

## Verified positioning

- IGUDAR does not replace the qualified professional.
- AI coordinates the analysis but does not invent physical results.
- Final validity depends on input data, applicable rules and professional review.
- Operational delivery target: 48 hours after a complete brief and required site data.
- Internal case study: Piazzale XX Settembre, Pordenone; the IGUDAR configuration recorded 39.3% fewer simulated casualties than the manual baseline in that specific scenario. This result is not a generalized guarantee.

## Intended users

- Professionisti e tecnici della sicurezza.
